# Planpaste

> Planpaste turns messy chats into clean action plans — paste any thread and get a shareable list of tasks, deadlines, and commitments.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of what Planpaste does and how it works.
- [About](/about): Mission and how Planpaste extracts actions from conversations.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Community reviews and ratings from Planpaste users.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Planpaste team.
- [Trust & Security](/trust): How Planpaste handles security, privacy, and your data.
- [WhatsApp task extractor guide](/guides/whatsapp-tasks): Step-by-step guide to turning WhatsApp group chats into action plans.
